[{"node":{"text":"“My grateful jeans” (long post alert)
As I declutter my stuffs, I know its going to be walk down memory lane. I have quite a good memory and can sometimes remember the most minute of details, the context, the stories and the emotions behind certain objects. This one deserves a post on its own. I clearly remembered I bought this pair of stretchable jeans, just before I ended my first maternity leave (so this was around Jun 2014). As a first time mom back then, I went through a lot of emotional ups & downs, taking on a new identity & responsibility, taking care of my first born during that first few months when I was home. Needless to say, this new identity also came with a brand new image of excess baggage. No one prep me that I wasn’t going to lose weight after delivering my baby. No one told me it will take a lot of effort to shed those extra kilos. Soon after, I knew I needed a change in my wardrobe to look decently enough. So I remembered shopping and feeling disheartened, as my choices became limited and nothing looks nice, on me at least. Then at last I found this pair, which is a size bigger than my usual. To me, it is more than a pair of jeans, it was like light at the end of tunnel, like I found water in a desert (brand name is Oasis btw), it gave me that little bit of confidence that I can “still look ok” being able to fit into this. Over the years, it served me so well, saw me through the post-partum of 3 kids. It feels almost like a fairy-god mother who’s always there to shelter me & give me courage & confidence whenever I needed it. Now that I don’t wear it anymore, I will be donating this away along with other stuffs, and I hope this can help/benefit whoever that gets it eventually. Though I don’t hold on to it materially, I will forever be grateful to how this pair of jeans stuck with me through thick & thin!
